description: Search NorthPoint's regulations library — the marketing rules that bind crypto and fintech promotion, one page per rule, each with the instrument and article it cites and the regulator's own source where one is published. Returns the matching rules ranked, with the citation (e.g. "Regulation (EU) 2023/1114 · Article 88(3)"), a summary, the page's section headings and the northpoint.fi URL to read. Filter by regime (mica, fca, gdpr, sec, vara), jurisdiction (EU, UK, US, Dubai) or regulator (ESMA, FCA, SEC, VARA, EDPB); query matches titles, citations and headings (e.g. "risk warning", "cooling off", "influencer", "reverse solicitation", "prior approval"). Information, not legal advice. No API key required.

query.description: Free-text search: the rule, topic, article or exchange name.

name: lookup_regulation
